messages.content: Use the provided tools to compute inventory value. Do not invent stock or price. Call both inventory and price for SKU A, in the same response if possible. After both tool results, return only JSON with sku and inventory_value.
What is the inventory value of SKU A? Use inventory and price before calculating.

function.name: inventory
function.description: Look up the quantity in stock for one SKU.

function.name: price
function.description: Look up the unit price for one SKU.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute inventory value = quantity in stock * unit price for SKU A. We have tools inventory and price. Must first call inventory with sku "A", then call price with sku "A". Then compute value. Then return JSON with sku and inventory_value. Must not invent values. So we need to call both tools. Then combine results. However, the system says we can only do one tool call per turn? Actually it says "In each turn you can either: - Send a message to the user. - Make a tool call. You cannot do both at the same time." So we can only make one tool call per turn. But we need both inventory and price. Possibly we can call one tool, get result, then call the other, then compute and respond. So we need to do a multi-step process: first call inventory, get quantity. Then call price, get unit price. Then compute value and respond with JSON. So the first step is to call inventory with sku "A". Then we will get a response. Then next turn we will call price. Then compute. Then return JSON. So we need to output a tool call now.

Thus we should call functions.inventory with {"sku":"A"}.
